sub_parameters.name: Name
sub_parameters.description:
The name of the filter. You can query by one or more filter names. Valid values:

- SupplierUid: The UID of the service provider.

- RegistrationId: The review ID.

- Status: The review status.

- SupplierName: The name of the service provider.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The value of the filter condition.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results.
